candidateOccurrences.sourceText: the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people passed over near Jericho.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The priests who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: WEB表記と割当表記が異なるが、文脈上の対応語を確認（sea of the plain）。同一性/訳語としての関係には限定を付す。

wikipediaSearchNoteJa: Names節はDead Seaを聖書で「Sea of Arabah」「Eastern Sea」とも呼ぶと述べる。JOS3:16の「sea of the Arabah」に対応する水域の参考とし、「Salt Sea」等の別名や現代湖岸を一つの境界点としない。
